newsitem.title: PERU: Peru anti-drug helicopter crashes, two dead.
newsitem.headline: Peru anti-drug helicopter crashes, two dead.

text.p: A police helicopter, given to Peru by the United States for its anti-drug fight, crashed on Friday in the northern jungle, killing two men and injuring seven others, police said.

The helicopter crashed close to Tarapoto, 510 miles (810 km) northeast of Lima, on a flight that was part of a mission to control and reduce the cultivation of coca leaf, the raw material for cocaine, the police said in a statement.
Authorities, who were investigating the causes of the crash, transported the dead and injured from the drug-running zone to Lima's police hospital.
U.S.-backed patrol programmes have helped local security forces restrict the number of routes available to drug traffickers in Peru, which produces more than 60 percent of the world's coca leaf.
